findings.why: The only source on record for BR-310 is Chisone (SUP-C). No controlled release or approval record covers Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) for BR-310 at a receiving plant for Nordhavn (CUST-NOR). The supplier master lists SUP-B only for blanks and bars, not extrusions. Absence of a record does not show the source is not approved, so a person must confirm whether a current release exists.
